transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I’m here because everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure on my house is just about paperwork and missed payments. But I know what's actually going on. The bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They keep trying to hand me documents, but... no amount of papers they show me changes what I’ve been seeing with my own eyes for almost two years now.

Over the past two years, have you noticed any distinct periods—lasting days or weeks—where your mood, energy, or sleep needs changed dramatically, such as feeling unusually elated, irritable, or full of energy, or conversely very depressed or hopeless?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, my sleep is fine and my energy is pretty normal. I haven't had any extreme highs or... or felt completely hopeless. Obviously, I'm stressed and angry because of what they're doing to me, but my mood itself hasn't been bouncing around. I'm just trying to deal with this situation they've put me in.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you don't seem to notice or hear?

No, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I mean, I know how it might sound when I talk about the bank and my job coordinating this, but my mind is perfectly clear. I'm just paying attention to the actual things they are doing in the real world, right in front of me. There aren't any imaginary voices or visions involved.

Do you have any medical conditions—such as a neurological illness, head injury, or thyroid problem—or do you use alcohol or any drugs, that started around the same time these beliefs about the bank and your job began?

No, I don't have any medical conditions. No head injuries or... thyroid problems, nothing like that. And I don't use drugs or have a drinking problem. So, no. None of this is because of a medical issue or something I took. 

I know you probably have to ask that, but these aren't just "beliefs" that popped up because I got sick or started drinking. It's just the reality of what's actually happening with my house and my job.

Aside from the situation with the bank and your job, how have things like your relationships with family or friends, your daily routines, and your ability to take care of yourself been over the past two years?

Well, my daily routine is pretty normal. As long as the foreclosure isn't involved, I'm fine. I still get up for work every day, I supervise my team, handle the schedules, and deal with customer issues. I take care of myself just like I always have. My relationships are... they're okay, just regular day-to-day stuff. 

The problems really only start when I get certain mail, or if the bank calls, or when workplace paperwork comes across my desk that's tied to what they are doing with the house. But outside of those specific things, everything else in my life is completely normal and I'm handling my responsibilities.
